prompt.description: What the agent is asked to investigate (e.g. a detection id + host).

group_id.description: Memory namespace for the run; use an isolated evallab namespace.

scoring.description: Which signals this case contributes to. Everything defaults to true; a case is a full test unless it says otherwise.

disposition.description: Score the verdict (accuracy, confusion, calibration, false-close, false-alarm). Set false for a case whose disposition is not reproducible enough to mean anything — it still scores ladder adherence and cost, and its `expected.disposition` stays as documentation of the right answer. See #128.

min_rung.description: Deepest evidence rung genuinely required to settle this case.
